broker.name: BlackBull Markets
broker.tagline: Its site names FSA (Seychelles). Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:500.
broker.about: BlackBull Markets publishes this address: Level 20, 188 Quay Street, Auckland 1010, New Zealand. The pages checked do not state a founding year. Account names on its site include ECN Standard, ECN Prime, Prime+, Standard, Raw, and Pro. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, cTrader, TradingView, and BlackBull CopyTrader. The site names these regulators: FSA (Seychelles). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:500. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.

other_fees.note: The support page shows more than one account table. One table lists ECN Standard, ECN Prime and Prime+ at US$0. Another lists Standard at US$50, Raw at US$100 and Pro at US$500. The MetaTrader 4 and MetaTrader 5 pages say there is no minimum deposit to open those platform accounts. There is not one figure for every account.
